views.rationale: AAPL's gross margin percentage increased to 46.3% in Q3 2024, up from 44.5% in Q3 2023, while CVX's gross margin percentage decreased to 43.8% in Q3 2024, down from 44.5% in Q3 2023.

AAPL's net sales increased 5% in Q3 2024, while BAC's net income for Global Markets increased $304 million to $1.4 billion in Q3 2024, a 27% increase, but this is partially offset by higher noninterest expense.

AMZN's filing mentions macroeconomic factors, including inflation, increased interest rates, significant capital market and supply chain volatility, and global economic and geopolitical developments, which will continue to impact their operations into Q3 2024.
GOOGL's operating margin increased 3% YoY, while JNJ's remained flat
GOOGL's 14% revenue growth outpaced KO's 6% growth, driven by a 9% increase in price, product & geographic mix
GS's Equities net revenues were 8% higher than the first half of 2023, while JPM's Banking & Payments revenue was 9% higher
JPM's net interest income was up 39% YoY, driven by the impact of balance sheet mix and higher rates, while KO's net operating revenues were up 6%
LIN's sales decreased 1% YoY, while GOOGL's revenue grew 14%
